mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.user_id, t1.role_id, t1.create_user_id, t1.update_user_id, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.is_delete FROM sys_user_role t1 WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_role SET is_delete = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
